title: Iterated local Gaussian limits of generic transverse polychromatic Lagrangian states on negatively curved manifolds
difficulty_reason: H3: semiclassical Liouville equidistribution alone does not identify a spatial local random-field law. The author obtains a finite-branch WKB representation after propagation, using hyperbolic/nowhere-stable geometry and a uniform inverse-Jacobian logarithmic distortion estimate to control branch amplitudes and local variation. Equal momenta are grouped before rationally independent phase directions are randomized by the shrinking spatial ball; Taylor remainder and torus equidistribution give fixed-timeC-infinity local laws. The long-time limit then combines local semiclassical spectral-measure identification with vanishing maximal branch weight and a multivariate Lindeberg/tightness argument. A separate one-common-time multijet incidence construction makes rational independence generic at almost every basepoint for all sufficiently large times. This geometry-to-local-probability construction and its genericity form one independent research-level framework; classical propagation/equidistribution inputs and internal helper results are not extra units.
